summary: Lotus Technology Inc. furnished a Form 6-K with a press release disclosing a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications notice dated October 28, 2026, stating the company failed the $1.00 minimum bid price rule under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) from September 16 to October 27, 2026. Nasdaq grants 180 calendar days, until April 26, 2027, to regain compliance via a closing bid of at least $1.00 per ADS for ten consecutive business days, with a possible additional extension. The notice has no immediate effect on listing; ADSs continue trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. Watch for a reverse-split or ADS-ratio action, near-term dilution risk and trading around $1.00.
